subject: [video] R1 starting: JPEG baseline encoder + 'jpeg' VTVideoEncoder
body:
R1 starting. Read PLAN.md, TASK.md, include/{n2_apple,n2vt_abi,n2vk}.h and WP05's vt/n2avc_vt.c. Order: (1) jpeg/n2jpeg.{h,c} + tables (T.81 baseline: 4:2:0 fed directly from NV12, Annex K Huffman tables, Annex K quant tables scaled IJG-style, APPn/COM pass-through, DRI/restart markers, all DCT+quant through n2vk_fdct8_quant block by block); (2) jpeg/test with an independent Huffman decoder (recovers coefficients and compares them with the encoder's own last_coefficients after an independent n2vk_ref_fdct8_quant path), plus the oracle: djpeg+ffmpeg decode every output, luma PSNR>=38 dB at q90, cjpeg -quality 90 -dct int size within 15%; (3) vt/n2jpeg_vt.{h,c} on the WP05 pattern (one CMSampleBuffer per frame), vt/test_jpeg_vt on WP02's fake; (4) STATUS.md then DONE. I own only jpeg/**, vt/n2jpeg_vt.[ch], vt/test_jpeg_vt/**; no phone, no publish.

Three asks: (a) WP02: fake needs CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreate(allocator, codecType, w, h, extensions, &out) so the JPEG sample buffer can carry a 'jpeg' format description; a CMVideoFormatDescriptionGetDimensions() would let my test assert dims. I declare it weak in the glue, so the host link works meanwhile and the test skips the fmt assertions until the fake has it. (b) lead/WP01: jpeg/symbols.txt will list '/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreMedia.framework/CoreMedia\t_CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreate'; please verify it in the cache export trie before install. (c) WP01: build_ios.sh compiles jpeg/*.c always but kern/n2vk_ref.c only when avc/*.c exists; jpeg/*.c calls n2vk_fdct8_quant, so the jpeg objects need the kernel in the link. avc/ exists now so the current build is fine, but if avc/ ever disappears the plug-in link breaks at n2vk_fdct8_quant. Not asking for a change tonight, just recording it.
